description: Generate high-fidelity UI/UX mockups for mobile and web apps using Atomic Design principles, via muapi.ai (Flux).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Feature/screen description, e.g. "crypto wallet home with price charts".

phases.prompt: Expand description '{{description}}' for platform '{{platform}}', theme '{{theme}}', style '{{style}}' into a UX brief. Name specific atomic components (glassmorphic buttons, input fields with 4px radius, iconic sidebars). Choose a layout pattern (F-Pattern for content-heavy, Z-Pattern for landing pages, grid dashboard for data-dense apps). Inject design tokens: Inter/Roboto geometric sans-serif, 8pt spacing grid, WCAG 2.1 accessible contrast. Enforce flat design or glassmorphism only - never photorealistic/skeuomorphic 'photograph of a screen'. Do not show hands, physical phones, or desks - pure UI mockup only.
